statement.p: Consider the vector field \vec F = (xe^{1-y}) \,\vec j. Assume x,y>0 and decide if

(a) The vector field is
?
parallel to the x-axis
parallel to the y-axis
parallel to neither axis .

(b) In the vector field, as x increases the vector lengths
?
increase
decrease
neither of these is true .

(c) In the vector field, as y increases the vector lengths
?
increase
decrease
neither of these is true .

p.em: (On a separate sheet of paper, sketch the vector field to see how your answers above are reflected in the vector field.)

static.solution:
(a) The vector field is parallel to the y-axis.
(b) As x increases the vector lengths increase.
(c) As y increases the vector lengths decrease.
The vector field is
(vectors are shown as line segments, with a dot at the tail of the vector).
